items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Osceola Blanchett was a piano player too, I think.

ctx.x: He never played on the boat, I don't think.

I don't know. There's so many people that are coming to me now that I want to look up. You know, there's a good many books about this that mention the band. Osceola Blanchett was a piano player too, I think. One of the books. It's hard to keep them all straight. I wanted to ask you about how your plans for the year would go. What you would do in the different poets. How did that work?

Well, we just stopped at Easttown one day, like a circus. We'd go to the next town. We'd operate on the upper Mississippi River and the upper Ohio. And go as far as St. Paul on the Mississippi and as far as Pittsburgh on the Ohio. And do that in the summertime. When we got to the terminus, like at St. Paul, we'd stay there about 10 days. Bigger town, Minneapolis, Paul. A million people would be in the two towns. And Pittsburgh is around 600, 700,000. So we'd stay there a longer time. But other towns would just…
